title: 특허법ㆍ실용신안법ㆍ의장법ㆍ상표법의시행에관한규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1

Article 3 (Transitional Measures concerning Cases Pending before the Supreme Court, etc.)
(1) Article 3 (2) of the respective Addenda to the Patent Act, etc. shall apply mutatis mutandis to cases in which a decision of the Appellate Trial Office on an appeal against a decision dismissing a petition for trial had been served at the time these Rules enter into force and no appeal to the Supreme Court had been filed.
(2) Where an appellate trial decision, a decision dismissing a petition for appellate trial, a decision by an appellate trial examiner dismissing an amendment, or a decision of the Appellate Trial Office on an appeal against a decision dismissing a petition for trial is served after these Rules enter into force and no appeal has been filed with the Supreme Court, an appeal may be filed with the Supreme Court within 30 days from the date of service of the trial decision or other decision.
(3) Where an appeal is filed under the main sentence of Article 3 (2) of the respective Addenda to the Patent Act, etc. or under Article 3 (1) or (2) of these Rules, a petition for appeal or re-appeal shall be submitted to the Supreme Court.
(4) Where a case appealed to the Supreme Court before these Rules enter into force remains pending and notice has not been given to the President of the Intellectual Property Tribunal, or where an appeal is filed under paragraph (3), the Supreme Court shall promptly notify the President of the Intellectual Property Tribunal thereof.
(5) Upon receipt of a notification under paragraph (4), the President of the Intellectual Property Tribunal shall forward the documents concerning the case to the Supreme Court without delay.
